note: Cross-packet sequences: replay the steps in order, carrying verifier state; each step gives its verdict and the operations held and done after it (operation -> invocation id).

sequences.name: an unverifiable not_executed statement does not release the hold
an unverifiable receipt does not record the operation as done
control: a verified not_executed statement releases the hold
control: a verified receipt records the operation as done
control: an independent operation proceeds while another is held
a single-use approval used in one packet is still used in the next
